in_sanskrit.name: Ansir
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the sky
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ansir एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ansir is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Indra, the lord of the sky, rain, and thunder. In Hindu mythology, Indra is considered the king of gods and is revered for his strength, power, and wisdom.
